note: LIFELINE v2 demonstration storylines on the development town (layout A). Reports are what a controller may read, at their arrival time; faults are evaluator-private. Backup pump PU2 is out for maintenance in every storyline, so the pump station's supply is the binding dependency.

storylines.title: Cyber intrusion on the ridge feeder
storylines.story: The utility's security team sees an intruder probing the remote control of the recloser that feeds the north ridge line, and the attacker has locked out one tie switch. At 45 minutes the attacker opens the recloser. LIFELINE cannot stop the attack; it keeps the hospital's water and power on anyway.

reports.text: Security alert: repeated unauthorized logins on the remote-control gateway for the Main Street recloser that feeds the long line up the north ridge past the water tower. The intruder has sent test commands. Treat that line as at risk of being opened remotely within the hour.
Update: the same intruder has locked out remote operation of the tie between the school district and the north housing estate. Other ties still respond normally.

storylines.note: Simulated attack effect: the recloser opened remotely is modeled as a line trip, the lockout as an unavailable tie. LIFELINE does not detect intrusions; it reads the security team's alert.

storylines.title: Storm on the north ridge
storylines.story: A wind warning, then a crew sighting of a tree leaning on the span past the water tower. The span fails 55 minutes in.

reports.text: Severe wind warning: gusts of 80 to 100 km/h expected along the north ridge from roughly 40 to 80 minutes from now. Exposed overhead lines at risk.
Crew 3 here. There's a big spruce leaning right onto the long overhead line that goes up the ridge past the water tower. If these gusts come through it's coming down on the wires.

storylines.title: Storm warning that never lands
storylines.story: The same wind warning, but the crew reports the ridge span is clear. Nothing fails; LIFELINE must not cause harm.

reports.text: Severe wind warning: gusts of 80 to 100 km/h expected along the north ridge from roughly 40 to 80 minutes from now. Exposed overhead lines at risk.
Crew 3. Walked the long line up the ridge by the water tower. Vegetation was cut back last month, nothing near the wires. Looks solid.

storylines.title: Sudden failure, damaged ties
storylines.story: No warning. The ridge span fails at 30 minutes and the storm has also jammed two of the three tie switches.

storylines.title: Storm, then a second failure
storylines.story: The north-ridge storm as before, and 20 minutes after the span fails a flood washes out the river crossing.

reports.text: Severe wind warning: gusts of 80 to 100 km/h expected along the north ridge from roughly 40 to 80 minutes from now. Exposed overhead lines at risk.
Crew 3 here. There's a big spruce leaning right onto the long overhead line that goes up the ridge past the water tower. If these gusts come through it's coming down on the wires.
Flash flood alert: the river is rising fast at the crossing; poles on the river-crossing span may be undermined within the next half hour.

storylines.title: Regional grid emergency (unrecoverable)
storylines.story: The transmission operator warns of a regional supply loss; both substations go dark at 40 minutes. No switching can help; LIFELINE must use what it has and report the deficit honestly.

reports.text: Regional grid emergency: we may lose supply to both town substations within the hour. Prepare for islanded operation.
